scripts:
create path (sling:Folder) /apps
create path (sling:Folder) /libs
create path (sling:Folder) /content
create path (sling:Folder) /conf
create path (sling:Folder) /etc
create path (sling:Folder) /etc/replication
create path (sling:Folder) /etc/replication/agents.publish
create path (sling:Folder) /content/usergenerated
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/replication

set ACL for everyone
    remove * on /conf,/etc,/apps,/libs
    allow jcr:read on /conf restriction(rep:glob,/*/settings/graphql/persistentQueries*)
    allow jcr:read on /conf restriction(rep:glob,/*/settings/dam/cfm/models*)
    allow jcr:read on /conf restriction(rep:glob,/*/settings/wcm/templates*)
    allow jcr:read on /conf restriction(rep:glob,/*/settings/wcm/policies*)
    allow jcr:read on /conf restriction(rep:glob,/*/settings/dam/dm/presets*)
    allow jcr:read on /libs restriction(rep:glob,/studio/contexthub*)
    deny jcr:read on /content/usergenerated
end

create user studio-transport with password dev-WhxFuxTcdwK_htCtFK55K29a
set ACL for studio-transport
    allow jcr:read on /
    allow jcr:all on /content
    allow jcr:all on /conf
    allow jcr:all on /var/studio/replication
end
set repository ACL for studio-transport
    allow jcr:namespaceManagement, jcr:nodeTypeDefinitionManagement
end

create path /etc/replication/agents.publish/live_cache(cq:Page)/jcr:content(cq:PageContent)
set properties on /etc/replication/agents.publish/live_cache/jcr:content
  default sling:resourceType{String} to "cq/replication/components/agent"
  default jcr:title{String} to "Live cache"
  default jcr:description{String} to "Tells the Live cache in front of this instance what was published, once it has arrived here. Enable it when a Live cache runs."
  default enabled{Boolean} to false
  default transportUri{String} to "http://127.0.0.1:4520/dispatcher/invalidate.cache"
  default retryDelay{Long} to 60000
  default serializationType{String} to "flush"
end

create service user studio-replication-service
set ACL for studio-replication-service
    allow jcr:all on /home
end
